title:
Epic used to update the 'Reliability.CloningModelSensorSelectionSelectedSensorsGrid' and
'Reliability.CloningModelSensorSelectionExcludedSensorsGrid' when the user includes or excludes sensors to
clone in the unified model cloning workflow.
It receives as payload:
- dataItems: Received when triggered by 'MULTIPLE_ROW' action. It contains the list of sensors ids included or
excluded by the user.
- obj: Received when is triggered by single 'ROW' action. It contains the sensor object the user wishes to
include or exclude..
- applicationStateId: The application state id that stores the sensors lists.
- componentId: The component id that triggers the epic.
name: CloningModelUpdateSensorListsEpic
